column1: # EXCLUDED.tsv -- gimpel: the programs of this package that are NOT IN THE SPITBOL DIALECT, out of the published denominator, one row per program: name<TAB>NOT_SPITBOL_DIALECT<TAB>the feature, its dialect, the oracle's own refusal and CSNOBOL4's verdict.

# THE TEST (Lon 2026-09-26 15:0x CDT, in-chat to the ceo, verbatim: "So the way to tell if a program is SPITBOL dialect is two-fold, 1st is rejected by SPITBOL, and 2nd why it is rejected is a CSNOBOL4 feature not supported. Then if these two are true it is NOT SPITBOL dialect."; ceo CEO-1286).

# BOTH halves must hold: a program sbl -bf refuses for any OTHER cause (a SPITBOL-documented feature the x64 fork lacks, a Macro SPITBOL 370 convention, a missing input, a UTF-8 BOM, lowercase source waiting for its case conversion, a program broken under CSNOBOL4 too) STAYS in the denominator, named in OUTSIDE_SPITBOL_BASELINE.tsv beside this file as debt.

# SPITBOL's own test deck (spitbol_testpgms/test1..8.spt and the csnobol4_suite copies diag1/diag2) is SPITBOL dialect BY ORIGIN (Lon 2026-09-26: "Get ALL 8 working in SCRIP since they are SPITBOL programs.") whatever the x64 fork refuses.

# EXCLUDED=6 of the shipped population; the suite row reads pass / (shipped - EXCLUDED) with EXCLUDED named. Measured 2026-09-26 against sbl -bf (the ONE oracle) and csnobol4 -b (the reference engine, never a grader); the probes are recorded in GOAL-CEO.md CEO-1286.

column3: assignment to BAL (BAL.sno line 11, graded through BAL_driver.sno); BAL is a protected variable in SPITBOL and an ordinary one in SNOBOL4/CSNOBOL4 (probe pg) -- a CSNOBOL4 feature SPITBOL does not support: sbl -bf BAL.sno(11) ERROR 042 attempt to change value of protected variable; csnobol4 runs it (ORACLE_ACCEPTANCE.tsv 2026-09-26)

the SNOBOL4 OPSYN(function, operator, 2) form in the included REDEFINE.INC line 17 (graded through INFINIP_driver.sno); SPITBOL's OPSYN with i=2 takes an unused operator as its first argument (probe pf) -- a CSNOBOL4 feature SPITBOL does not support: sbl -bf REDEFINE.INC(17) ERROR 156 opsyn first arg is not correct operator name; csnobol4 runs it (ORACLE_ACCEPTANCE.tsv 2026-09-26)
